text: Based on the evidence, I strongly prefer evidence about track records and what has worked before. The fact that we are the first district statewide to try the model is a strong motivator to adopt this schedule change, as it is an established proven approach. Additionally, the improvement in attendance every term since switching also suggests a positive outcome for the new schedule. The fact that a bus route consolidation under the new times saves forty thousand a year further supports the merits of the new schedule.
